commands.author: jcooley8

target.title: Polish iOS onboarding and chat critique fixes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The OpenClaw iOS critique wall surfaced onboarding, setup, chat-empty-state, and phone tab issues that made the app feel less clear than the underlying product. This PR applies those approved critique fixes directly in the iOS app, keeping Pincushion mobile-wall/product infrastructure work separate.

## Why This Change Was Made

The feedback clustered around four product issues:

- 
- native-app-i18n: entries=2368 changed=false -> First-run onboarding used internal terms, repeated pairing copy, exposed a confusing close affordance, and made security/setup guidance harder to act on.
- Gateway/auth error states did not give enough recovery context or a copyable command.
- Connected chat opened with no starter guidance, and the composer showed controls that did not match the current input state.
- Phone navigation split Chat/Talk while reviewers expected one prominent chat destination.

## User Impact

- New users see clearer onboarding steps, app-consistent branding, a collapsible device-access info section, copyable `/pair qr` and `openclaw pair token` commands, and a single canonical connected endpoint.
- Setup/manual connection CTAs now read as buttons, setup-code flow explains what applying does, and successful pairing lands on a clearer `Go to Chat` action.
- Empty chat includes three tappable starter prompts, the `?` agent badge falls back to initials, the clean composer hides Send until useful, and the old attachment affordance is now a generic `More` button.
- Phone tabs are now `Control -> Agent -> Settings -> Chat`; Talk/voice routes map into Chat while iPad/sidebar Talk support remains available.
- Settings rows now satisfy the existing source guards: Channels includes routing context and Location uses a menu-style control instead of a segmented picker.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `pnpm native:i18n:check` -> `native-app-i18n: entries=2368 changed=false`
- `swiftformat --config config/swiftformat apps/ios/Sources/Onboarding/OnboardingWizardSteps.swift apps/ios/Sources/Onboarding/OnboardingWizardView.swift apps/ios/Sources/Design/SettingsProTabSections.swift apps/ios/Sources/Design/ChatProTab.swift apps/ios/Sources/RootTabs.swift apps/ios/Sources/RootTabsNavigation.swift apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawChatUI/ChatComposer.swift apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawChatUI/ChatView.swift`
- `xcodebuild -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClawChatUI -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -configuration Debug build`
- `xcodebuild -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build`
- `xcodebuild -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -only-testing:OpenClawTests/RootTabsPresentationTests -only-testing:OpenClawTests/RootTabsSourceGuardTests test`

Notes: local simulator validation used a generated Xcode project and `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO` because this environment does not have the upstream signing profiles. SwiftLint reported 5 existing non-serious warnings in unchanged large files.

## Pincushion Pin Triage

Source report: https://www.pincushion.io/r/V0FIzN4Wj7cMOTd_6-2LKQ

| # | Pin ID | Feedback | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ann_mr3ps5m8kv18c4 | First-launch Close exits onboarding. | Addressed: Close is hidden on intro/welcome; later skip reads Set Up Later. |
| 2 | ann_mr3ps7vhmjbnmd | Replace internal “secure node” subtitle. | Addressed: intro says the phone becomes OpenClaw’s eyes, ears, and voice. |
| 3 | ann_mr3ps8t610lk5e | Duplicate `/pair qr` caption. | Addressed: redundant status caption is suppressed unless needed. |
| 4 | ann_mr3ps9to2gz8z7 | “OpenClaw chat” assumes context. | Addressed: pairing copy anchors to OpenClaw on the computer. |
| 5 | ann_mr3psau4yrxxol | Authentication header repeats. | Addressed: section is now Gateway credentials. |
| 6 | ann_mr3psbrte10ifi | Auth error needs token source. | Addressed: adds `openclaw pair token` command with copy affordance. |
| 7 | ann_mr3pscmpvl7i4h | Protocol error contradicts itself. | Addressed: error state shows one status plus one recovery step. |
| 8 | ann_mr3psdkckb1pbb | Empty chat needs starter prompts. | Addressed: adds three tappable starter prompts. |
| 9 | ann_mr3psektuznpxj | `?` avatar badge looks broken. | Addressed: `?` is ignored and falls back to initials/OC. |
| 10 | ann_mr3psfo6yhv24b | Success duplicates host. | Addressed: shows one canonical endpoint. |
| 11 | ann_278af270-38f0-4de8-9a14-013c5e93970f | Icon missing. | Addressed: onboarding uses the OpenClaw mark and chat badge fallback is hardened. |
| 12 | ann_699bd78c-e1af-48a4-a1db-9dcdb384b53a | Branding inconsistent. | Addressed: gateway onboarding uses the app mark instead of a generic QR glyph. |
| 13 | ann_7f4359bb-1402-4137-bb6e-6805f902a083 | Radios/switches inconsistent. | Addressed: onboarding mode rows now use switch-style indicators. |
| 14 | ann_8fd1d05e-9b4e-4b25-84c7-f36b3051ef80 | Button reads poorly and is red. | Addressed: reset onboarding is separated by a divider and no longer uses destructive red styling. |
| 15 | ann_b1b3e3c1-d550-4557-95e3-41d5c27270b2 | Close button should be hidden/deleted. | Addressed with pin 1. |
| 16 | ann_0dd51125-bf42-4f96-92bc-371c3eeab046 | Value prop should be steps. | Addressed: first-run value prop is expressed as three setup steps. |
| 17 | ann_affcadfa-9420-42a7-8add-aa5df04bcb80 | Nobody reads the long notice. | Addressed: device-access details are behind an info disclosure. |
| 18 | ann_0bfae751-7853-4c47-a069-75bfa324fa41 | Avoid repeating app-store copy. | Addressed: onboarding copy is shorter and task-focused. |
| 19 | ann_d463e9af-7d2e-47b4-9a7f-d019f748af7a | Copy command option needed. | Addressed: pairing and token commands can be copied. |
| 20 | ann_f94f9c05-cee6-4c27-b33e-b4d8208a3fa3 | Redundant to How to pair UI. | Addressed with pin 3. |
| 21 | ann_dcaab8d6-8302-40cc-a2ea-17ff9b0b2b1a | Buttons should be bottom/safe-area consistent. | Addressed for the primary onboarding/success CTAs and setup/manual CTAs; deeper form layout can continue separately if needed. |
| 22 | ann_41a56b03-0672-40b0-b673-b22b43349f4f | Hide Send until input. | Addressed: clean composer shows Talk when idle and Send/Stop only when useful. |
| 23 | ann_4afcc69a-8e12-4b9b-a6cd-3fb28ef84202 | Attachment should be a More button. | Addressed: clean attachment affordance is `More` with ellipsis icon/accessibility label. |
| 24 | ann_35593e88-6748-4688-8b18-d4015011aeeb | Simplify Voice/Chat tabs and make Chat prominent. | Addressed: phone tabs become Control, Agent, Settings, Chat; talk/voice initial tabs map to Chat. |
| 25 | ann_723d53a7-9eba-4cb7-b85d-9f3e72ef2028 | Buttons should share behavior/colors. | Addressed: setup/manual CTAs now use large prominent labels and consistent icons. |
| 26 | ann_1981f9d9-6be4-4236-99e0-59874c3b0435 | Paste input and Apply button look identical. | Addressed: Apply Setup Code is a large prominent button with icon and explanatory footer. |
| 27 | ann_cf3a5413-491f-4381-b863-4519daadb526 | Applying setup had unclear result. | Addressed: setup footer clarifies that applying starts connection automatically. |
| 28 | ann_eeeb0308-2dca-411c-b942-82b4c50fdbfb | Connected success button destination unclear. | Addressed: success CTA now reads Go to Chat. |

Archived E2E pins were excluded from this PR.

## Future Mobile Critique

- Real mobile critique runs should pair screenshots with simulator accessibility dumps, screen identifiers, and stable semantic labels so an agent can map feedback back to native source without guessing.
- Each critique should preserve the exact capture/run plan, including screen routes and simulator state, so another agent can reproduce it.
- App fixes should land in the mobile app repo, while Pincushion/mobile-wall improvements should remain a separate product-infrastructure PR.
- Android should follow the same screenshot-plus-semantics contract through adb/uiautomator or Compose semantics.
